query: SELECT a.clip_db_id AS "clip_db_id!" FROM social_media_clip_approval a WHERE a.state = $1 AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM jsonb_array_elements_text( CASE WHEN jsonb_typeof(a.approved_platforms) = 'array' THEN a.approved_platforms ELSE '[]'::jsonb END) AS p(platform) WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM twitch_clips_upload_queue q WHERE q.clip_id = a.clip_db_id::bigint AND q.platform = p.platform)) ORDER BY a.decided_at ASC NULLS FIRST, a.clip_db_id ASC LIMIT $2
